collectible.title: Stocking's Stockings
collectible.subtitle: Stocking Anarchy's Striped Stockings
collectible.text: "I always charge rich creeps and weirdos for my sweaty, used stockings... But you can keep them for free. You can't turn them into swords! That's angel-only shit. But I heard they might make you better at coding."

collectible.title: Honekoneko Plushie
collectible.subtitle: It means Bone Kitten
collectible.text:
This is why she doesn't have it. You have it. She doesn't know you have it. And it's not like you can tell her about it, either.
She better doesn't find out you have it.
collectible.unlock: See Stocking crushing on another character.

collectible.title: Beach Flower Thingy
collectible.subtitle: I think it's a hibiscus?
collectible.text:
Stocking is not fond of the beach nor how the coarse and rough sand gets everywhere. But if putting a flower on her head and a bikini gets guys to buy her drinks and ice cream just to watch her licking, that's a pretty sweet deal for her.
What's a "Hawaii"?

Then do it again with other three different characters.
